annotations.rationale: Names Kevin Connor as director and connects his dinosaur adventure film The Land That Time Forgot to an Amicus project for three or four Edgar Rice Burroughs films. This is a concrete entry for investigating the director/series clause of q4. Later full text names sequel The People That Time Forgot. It does not establish the target actor, 91-minute runtime, or nephew collaboration; count only as partial useful source lead. The proof set is deliberately limited to facts actually needed for this partial classification.

proof_alternatives.quote: Amicus had got a deal with Edgar Rice Burroughs' estate to make three or four movies based on his books. Producer Milton Subotsky handed me a script for The Land That Time Forgot, about a crew of first world war sailors who discover an island inhabited by dinosaurs and prehistoric men.
